data.name: Iqtidar
data.gender_notes: Iqtidar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: To have the power to overcome obstacles and achieve success. The name Iqtidar carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Iqtidar usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Iqtidar signifies the triumph of the spiritual self over the material self, and the achievement of inner peace and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Iqtidar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Triumph.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqtidar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: اقتدار
in_arabic.meaning: القدرة على الحكم أو السيطرة على شيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل 'اقتدر' والذي يعني التمكن من الحكم أو الإدارة. يوحي الاسم بقوة الشخصية والقدرة على التحكم في الأمور، مما يعطي صاحب الاسم صفة القيادة والسيطرة. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران الآية 26 'ولله ملك السماوات والأرض وما بينهما يخلق ما يشاء والله على كل شيء قدير'، مما يبرز معنى القدرة الإلهية.

in_urdu.name: اقتدار
in_urdu.meaning: حکم کرنے یا کسی چیز پر قابو پانے کی طاقت
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام 'اقتدر' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کو سنبھالنے یا حکومت کرنے کی طاقت۔ یہ نام شخصیت کی مضبوطی اور معاملات پر قابو پانے کی صلاحیت کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے، جو شخص کو ایک رہنما اور کنٹرول کرنے والا بناتا ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہوا، یہ اسلامی روایت میں انتہائی اہمیت کا حامل ہے، خاص طور پر جب اس کا تعلق قرآن کی آیات سے کیا جائے جہاں 'قدرت' اور 'اقتدار' جیسے الفاظ کا استعمال ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इक़्तिदार

in_english.name: Iqtidar
in_english.meaning: Power or ability to govern or control something
in_english.long_meaning: The name Iqtidar is derived from the Arabic verb 'aqtadara', which means to have the power or ability to govern or control. It signifies strong personality and capability to manage affairs, connoting leadership and control. Etymologically, it stems from the Arabic root 'q-w-d' which is related to governance and capability. In Islamic tradition, this name holds significant importance as it reflects divine attributes of power and control as mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah Al-Imran, Verse 26.

It inspires individuals with this name to strive for success and to never give up, no matter the challenges they may encounter. In the Islamic context, it is a reminder of Allah's promise of reward for those who persevere in the face of hardship.

It encourages individuals to rely on their faith and trust in Allah's plan for their lives, even when the path forward may seem uncertain or difficult. The name also serves as a reminder of the importance of self-improvement and spiritual growth, as the true source of power and success comes from within. Ultimately, "Iqtidar" is a name that calls individuals to be warriors of faith, striving for spiritual progress in all aspects of their lives.
